item.title: IAF’s Shubhanshu Shukla Awarded Ashoka Chakra at Republic Day Celebrations
item.description: GUWAHATI: Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla of the Indian Air Force was awarded the Ashoka Chakra, India’s highest peacetime gallantry award on Monday, January 26 during Republic Day celebrations. The award was announced on Sunday, January 25. item.title: Hally War Named for Padma Shri for Preserving Meghalaya’s Living Root Bridges
item.description: GUWAHATI: Hally War, a resident of Siej village in Meghalaya’s East Khasi Hills, has been named for the Padma Shri in the social service category, recognising his lifelong contribution to preserving the state’s living root bridge tradition. The announcement is part of the central government’s list of 113 Padma Shri recipients released on the eve of Republic Day. item.title: President Murmu Unfurls Tricolour at Kartavya Path on 77th Republic Day
item.description: GUWAHATI: President Droupadi Murmu unfurled the National Flag at Kartavya Path in New Delhi on Monday, January 26, marking the 77th Republic Day of India with solemn grandeur. The unfurling of the Tricolour was followed by the National Anthem. item.title: Five from Assam Among 113 Padma Shri Awardees for 2026
item.description: GUWAHATI: Five individuals from Assam have been named among the 113 Padma Shri awardees for 2026, as announced by the Union government, recognising their contributions across art, culture, agriculture and public affairs. ALSO READ: Assam Governor Unfurls Tricolour, Leads Republic Day Celebrations in Guwahati According to a press note issued by the Ministry of Home Affairs on January 25, 2026, the list of Padma Award recipients was approved by the President of India as part of the annual honours.
